keywords: Petitioner sought intervention of this Court to obtain permanent pension and quash the decision for not granting \'combat casualty status\' for injury allegedly sustained from terrorist attack. Held - Based on evidence, decision of injury due to misfire of own weapon is not unreasonable. Application dismissed without costs.
